properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.config-source
properties.description: RabbitMQ config source. local: load rabbit.yml from classpath or ./config/<profile>/; nacos: pull rabbit.yml from Nacos at startup when server-addr is configured.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.confirm-timeout
properties.description: Milliseconds to wait for the AMQP 1.0 delivery outcome on the asynchronous send path.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.management.enabled
properties.description: Enable the RabbitMQ Management HTTP API used for queue/exchange/binding operations. AMQP 1.0 has no in-protocol topology declaration.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.management.url
properties.description: Base URL of the RabbitMQ Management API.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.management.username
properties.description: Username for the Management API; falls back to the AMQP connection username.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.management.password
properties.description: Password for the Management API; falls back to the AMQP connection password.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.management.virtual-host
properties.description: Virtual host used by the Management API; falls back to spring.rabbitmq.virtual-host.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.thread-pool.core-size
properties.description: Core thread count of the async channel-setup executor.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.thread-pool.max-size
properties.description: Max thread count; only effective when the queue is full, or immediately when queue-capacity <= 0.

properties.name: maple.framework.rabbitmq.thread-pool.queue-capacity
properties.description: Queue capacity of the async executor; <= 0 uses a synchronous queue so max-size takes effect immediately.

properties.name: maple.framework.mq.rabbitmq.enable
properties.description: Enable the default RabbitMQ queue listener.

properties.name: maple.framework.mq.rabbitmq.default-queue-name
properties.description: Queue name consumed by the default listener; overrides spring.rabbitmq.default-queue-name.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.addresses
properties.description: Legacy comma separated host:port list; the first entry is used as the AMQP 1.0 endpoint and takes precedence over host/port.

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.virtual-host
properties.description: Virtual host applied to the AMQP 1.0 open frame; spring.amqp.virtual-host takes precedence when set.
